canonical.title: IT Conferences & Tech Events in Bangkok / Nonthaburi 2026

parent.title: Weekend in Nonthaburi: Michelin Dinner + Pak Kret itinerary

siblings.title: Things to do in Nonthaburi and within 30 km
siblings.summary: A weekend itinerary built around Pak Kret: Koh Kret on Saturday morning, Rattanakosin or Chatuchak on Sunday, with a workable Saturday-night plan for the late ride home from a Michelin dinner.

siblings.title: Nonthaburi's 1-star Michelin restaurants
siblings.summary: Nonthaburi has two 1-star Michelin restaurants in 2026, both in Pak Kret: AKKEE (contemporary tasting counter) and Suan Thip (refined Royal Thai in riverside gardens).

sources.title: Techsauce Global Summit
sources.claim: Techsauce Global Summit 2026 runs Aug 26–28 at QSNCC, Bangkok, with 20,000+ attendees, 130+ sessions, 200+ exhibitors.

sources.title: IAIT 2026
sources.claim: IAIT 2026 runs Jun 17–19 at KX Building, KMUTT; IEEE CIS co-organised; theme: Trustworthy AI and Cybersecurity; 6,500 THB attendee fee.

sources.title: Microsoft Build //localhost:Bangkok
sources.claim: Microsoft Build //localhost:Bangkok is a free in-person event on Jun 21, 2026 at 991/1 Rama I Rd, Pathum Wan.

sources.title: CYSEC Thailand 2026
sources.claim: CYSEC Thailand 2026 takes place Jul 22 at Royal Orchid Sheraton Riverside Hotel; CYSEC Global's SE Asia debut.

sources.title: DigiTech ASEAN Thailand 2026
sources.claim: DigiTech ASEAN Thailand 2026 runs Nov 25–27 at IMPACT Hall 7–8, Nonthaburi, 400+ exhibitors, 12,000+ attendees.

sources.title: IMPACT venue — DigiTech ASEAN
sources.claim: IMPACT venue confirms DigiTech ASEAN & AI Connect 2026 dates as November 25–27 in Hall 7–8.

sources.title: Bangkok Tech Mixer
sources.claim: Bangkok Tech Mixer meets every Friday from 7pm at 8855 Restaurant & Bar, Sukhumvit Soi 8; free entry.

sources.title: AI Tinkerers Bangkok — CreateWith
sources.claim: AI Tinkerers Bangkok is part of a 220-city global network with 103,000+ members.

sources.title: GDG Bangkok
sources.claim: GDG Bangkok runs periodic free workshops on Google Cloud and AI.

sources.title: IMPACT Exhibition Centre
sources.claim: IMPACT Exhibition Centre is at Pakkred District, Nonthaburi; 140,000 sqm usable indoor space, opened 1999.

sources.title: True Digital Park 2026 — TechNode
sources.claim: True Digital Park hosted 1,600+ international events and has 6,000+ innovation partners.

sources.title: Test Automation Summit Bangkok 2026
sources.claim: Test Automation Summit Bangkok is scheduled for June 11, 2026; organised by Testingmind.

sources.title: DX Summit Thailand 2026
sources.claim: Digital Transformation Summit Thailand 2026 is on Oct 28, targeting 200+ C-level executives.

sources.title: International Congress on Artificial Intelligence 2026
sources.claim: International Congress on Artificial Intelligence 2026 runs Nov 19–20 at Ambassador Hotel Bangkok, hybrid format.

sources.title: AI Tinkerers Bangkok
sources.claim: AI Tinkerers Bangkok is a monthly meetup for local AI engineers and builders.

sources.title: Bangkok AI & Tech Builders
sources.claim: Bangkok AI & Tech Builders is a weekly Wednesday meetup for AI builders at cafes and coworking spaces.

sources.title: Global AI Bangkok
sources.claim: Global AI Bangkok organises monthly free evening events; 791 members; hosts AgentCamp and Season of AI series.

sources.title: True Digital Park
sources.claim: True Digital Park is SE Asia's largest tech and startup campus at 230,000 sqm in South Sukhumvit.

sources.title: Cybersec Asia × TICW 2026
sources.claim: Cybersec Asia × Thailand International Cyber Week 2026 ran Feb 4–5 at QSNCC, 4,000+ visitors, 140 exhibitors from 15 countries.

sources.title: Money20/20 Asia
sources.claim: Money20/20 Asia 2026 ran Apr 21–23 at QSNCC; Asia's largest fintech conference.

sources.title: AWS Summit Bangkok 2026
sources.claim: AWS Summit Bangkok 2026 was a free one-day event on May 28 at QSNCC with 40+ sessions; content now on-demand.

sources.title: CYSEC Thailand 2026 — Infosec Conferences
sources.claim: CYSEC Thailand 2026 classified as cloud security event, July 22, 2026, Bangkok.
